ruleDefinitions.name: Ntdsutil Abuse
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential abuse of ntdsutil to dump ntds.dit database Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "ESENT" AND (event_id = 216 OR event_id = 325 OR event_id = 326 OR event_id = 327) AND Data = RGX(".*ntds\\\.dit.*"))
